description: Mission photographs or explicitly labeled regional references. Reviewed rectangular crops remove mosaic gaps and distracting hardware; original files and source links are retained. Provenance: docs/reference/mars-photo-audit-2026-11-20/provenance.json and docs/reference/mars-scene-rebuild-2026-11-20/photo-provenance.json. Additional source replacements: docs/reference/gale-photo-navigation-2026-11-20/photo-provenance.json.

delta-front.caption: 18 April 2021 · Kodiak. Enhanced-color Mastcam-Z image; cropped to the butte. Regional reference from an earlier viewpoint.
delta-front.alt: Kodiak’s layered rock faces and talus slopes, cropped from the NASA Mastcam-Z image
delta-front.detail: Look at the horizontal layers in Kodiak’s cliff face.

seitah.caption: Sols 181–182 · Seitah. Enhanced-color panorama.
seitah.alt: Low exposed rocks among dark sandy pockets

depot.caption: Sol 684 · Three Forks selfie, near the sol-693 tour stop.
depot.alt: Perseverance beside a sample tube on the depot floor
depot.detail: A selfie gives the rover and the sample-depot ground a human sense of scale.

landing.caption: Sols 3–11 · Landing plain. Enhanced-color panorama.
landing.alt: Rocky landing plain and distant ridges

bright-angel.caption: Sol 1178 · Bright Angel, near the sol-1182 stop. Enhanced color. Cropped detail.
bright-angel.alt: Light-toned fractured bedrock beside darker sand
bright-angel.detail: Look at the cracked pale bedrock beside the darker sandy ground.

margin.caption: Sols 933–944 · Turquoise Bay in the Margin Unit, near the sol-950 stop. Natural color. Cropped detail.
margin.alt: Broad pale rock exposures and low margin ridges
margin.detail: Look at the pale rock shelves and the sand between them.

neretva.caption: Sol 1155 · Neretva Vallis, near the sol-1156 stop. Enhanced color.
neretva.alt: Sandy channel floor, scattered rocks and a layered valley wall

upper-fan.caption: Sols 789–791 · Belva overlook, near the sol-793 stop. Enhanced color.
upper-fan.alt: Fractured pale rock overlooking Belva’s sandy bowl and layered rim

beyond-rim.caption: Sol 1516 · Falbreen in the western-rim region; regional reference for the sol-1502 stop. Enhanced color.
beyond-rim.alt: Pale cracked pavement, dark sand and low ridges

frontier.caption: Sol 1980 · Navcam at rover reference 91 / 970, the pinned endpoint.
frontier.alt: Perseverance’s rocky western frontier seen by its navigation camera

rim.caption: Sols 1356–1358 · Jezero rim, near the sol-1354 stop. Enhanced color.
rim.alt: Wheel tracks descend across the broad crater-rim view

landing.caption: 8–9 August 2012 · View from Bradbury Landing toward lower Mount Sharp. NASA’s cropped Mastcam mosaic, white-balanced to Earth-like lighting; original 2 km scale retained.
landing.alt: Distant layered foothills of Mount Sharp beyond dark dunes, viewed from Curiosity’s landing site
landing.detail: Look beyond the dark dunes to Mount Sharp’s distant layers. The 2 km scale shows how far this landscape extends.

plains.caption: Sol 437 · 28 October 2013 · Rocky plains approaching Cooperstown. Monochrome, two-frame Navcam view. Earlier regional reference for this sol-504 stop.
plains.alt: Open rocky plain with the low Cooperstown outcrop below the distant crater horizon
plains.detail: Compare the scattered rocks and shallow outcrop with the open plain. This earlier view shows the same traverse region, rather than this stop’s exact viewpoint.

yellowknife.caption: Sol 125 · Navcam at rover reference 5 / 1398. Monochrome panorama. Cropped detail.
yellowknife.alt: Flat fractured rock and scattered stones at Yellowknife Bay
yellowknife.detail: Look at the flat rock broken into slabs by dark cracks.

foothills.caption: Sol 997 · Navcam at rover reference 48 / 1570. Monochrome panorama. Cropped detail.
foothills.detail: Look at the large broken slabs scattered across the slope.

transition.caption: Sol 3074 · Mont Mercou in daylight, near the sol-3072 stop. Left Navcam.
transition.alt: Layered Mont Mercou cliff with fractures and ledges visible in daylight
transition.detail: Look at the cliff’s thin beds and larger vertical fractures.

glen.caption: Sol 2481 · Mastcam view at Glen Etive. Raw camera color.

murray.caption: Sol 1454 · Murray Buttes. Mastcam regional reference from an earlier viewpoint than the sol-1500 stop.
murray.alt: Angular layered outcrops above loose sandy talus at Murray Buttes
murray.detail: Follow the broken ledges above the sandy slopes.

ridge.caption: Sols 1999–2000 · Navcam at rover reference 68 / 2626. Monochrome panorama. Cropped detail.
ridge.alt: Low ridge, fractured rock and distant mountain slopes
ridge.detail: Look at the pale fractured rock exposed through darker soil.

higher.caption: Sol 4500 · Devil’s Gate ridge and the base of Texoli butte. Monochrome Navcam.
higher.alt: Small ridgeline on the right and Texoli butte on the left
higher.detail: Look for the layered slope on the left and the broken ridge on the right.

frontier.caption: Sol 5016 · Salar de Vacas bedrock close-up, near the sol-5021 endpoint. MAHLI focus merge.
frontier.alt: Small disc-shaped mineral features in brushed bedrock
frontier.detail: Photo: disc-shaped features just 3–4 mm across. Zoom in to inspect them.

gediz.caption: 19 August 2023 · Gediz Vallis Ridge. Cropped Mastcam panorama; Earth-like color balance. Regional reference from an earlier viewpoint than the sol-3972 stop.
gediz.alt: Jumbled dark blocks on the low crest and apron of Gediz Vallis Ridge
gediz.detail: Compare the loose dark blocks with the finer material between them.

sulfates.caption: Sol 3506 · Navcam at rover reference 95 / 3020. Monochrome panorama. Cropped detail.
sulfates.alt: Sandy pockets and broken rock on sulfate-bearing slopes
sulfates.detail: Look at the eroded ridgeline and the broken rock below it.
